title: Add Subscription Plans, UPI Payment, and Top-Left 3-Dot Menu

requirements.text: Add a subscription plans screen accessible from the app. The screen must display two plan options: Monthly Subscription and Yearly Subscription. Each plan card should clearly show the plan name, price, billing cycle, and a list of included benefits. The yearly plan should highlight savings compared to the monthly plan (e.g., 'Save 20%'). Include a 'Subscribe' or 'Get Started' button on each plan card.

quotes: Add a monthly and yearly subscription option

acceptanceCriteria: A subscription screen exists with Monthly and Yearly plan cards
Each card shows plan name, price, billing period, and feature list
Yearly plan shows a savings badge or discount indicator compared to monthly
Each card has a Subscribe/Get Started CTA button
The screen is accessible from the 3-dot menu

requirements.text: On the subscription plans screen, display a payment methods section listing all supported payment methods: UPI, Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, and Wallets. Each method should be shown with a recognizable icon or label. The UPI option must be prominently listed. When a user selects a plan and clicks Subscribe, they should be shown a payment method selector UI (no actual transaction processing required — UI flow only).

acceptanceCriteria: Payment methods section lists UPI, Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, and Wallets
Each payment method has a distinct icon or label
UPI is prominently displayed in the payment methods list
Clicking Subscribe on a plan opens a payment method selector UI
The payment flow is a UI-only mock (no real transaction)

requirements.text: Add a 3-dot vertical kebab menu button in the top-left corner of the home screen header, styled like a professional mobile app. Tapping the button opens a slide-out drawer or dropdown menu containing navigation links: Home, Practice Quiz, Browse by Topic, Browse by Year, Score History, Subscription Plans, and Admin Panel. The menu must be dismissible by tapping outside or pressing a close button. Apply the existing parchment/teal/gold theme to the menu.

acceptanceCriteria: A vertical 3-dot (kebab) menu icon is visible in the top-left corner of the home screen header
Tapping the icon opens a drawer or dropdown navigation menu
Menu contains links to all main screens including Subscription Plans
Menu is dismissible by clicking/tapping outside it
Menu styling matches the existing parchment/teal/gold visual theme
Menu is present across all main screens (persistent header)

requirements.text: Add a backend data structure and functions to store subscription plan definitions (plan name, price, billing cycle, features list) as stable state in backend/main.mo. Expose a query function `getSubscriptionPlans` that returns all available plans. No payment processing logic is required — only plan metadata storage and retrieval.

acceptanceCriteria: backend/main.mo defines a SubscriptionPlan record type with name, price (Text), billingCycle (Text), and features ([Text])
Stable state initialized with Monthly and Yearly plan records
getSubscriptionPlans query function returns all plans without authorization check
Existing backend functions are unaffected

constraints: No real payment gateway integration — payment method selection is UI-only mock
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor (backend/main.mo)
Maintain the existing parchment/teal/gold Unani manuscript visual theme across all new UI
nonGoals: Actual payment processing or Stripe/UPI gateway integration
User account billing management or invoice generation
